meta.description: Delegates to the app's configured lead provider (Playwright, Hunter, Apollo, or mock -- selected via LEAD_PROVIDER, see lib/providers/registry.ts::leadProviderChain) via POST /api/providers/lead/decision-makers, passing the company resolved by WF_05. This workflow never needs to know which provider actually ran. LinkedIn URLs only ever come through as provider data (a company's own published team-page links, or Hunter/Apollo); absent => NOT_FOUND, never fabricated.
